note: Every player of Madden NFL 06's launch roster (the 2005 season) as [name, EA team id, Madden position, overall], read by npm run sync:madden-seasons from the sources scripts/data/nfl-seasons.json pins; npm run build:nfl-seasons builds the season from it.

remarks: The spreadsheets rate SS Ed Reed and P Shane Lechler 99, which maddenratings.net's own 99 Club note leaves out; no other copy of the launch roster survives to settle it, so the spreadsheets stand (a punter plays no part).
